about: The masters of the knightly orders (order 96, D-193): the Grand Master of each elite order of the realms (A.POSTS 'order:' posts), generated people, never stored here. Each is a profile computed from the world as it is (src/world/9999977-figures). This file holds only the rule and the words.

category.name: Masters of the Orders
category.note: The Grand Masters of the elite orders, the few hundred knights a realm counts as its best. Their names are known across the continent.

voice.master: {Name} is Grand Master of {order}, the elite order of {realm}.
